messages.subject: Re: 用R寫猜數字幾A幾B那遊戲，要怎麼寫??? 麻煩有個示範
parts:
參考看看

ans <- sample(0:9,4)
ans
repeat
{
cat("請輸入4個不重複的數字(0~9),"\n")
ent <-scan()
a <- 0
b <- 0
for ( i in 1:4)
{
if( ent[i]== ans[i])
{
a <- a+1
}
else
for ( j in 1:4)
{
if ( ent[i] == ans[j])
{
b <- b+1
}

}
}
cat(a,"A", b ,"B" ,"\n")
if(a == 4)
{
cat("猜對了!")
break
}
}

1: a <- 0

+ {

錯誤: 找不到物件 'ent'
> cat(a,"A", b ,"B" ,"\n")

錯誤在cat(a, "A", b, "B", "\n") : 找不到物件 'a'
